# Samyoj — AI-Powered WhatsApp CRM

> Samyoj (samyoj.com) is an AI-powered customer communication CRM and Official WhatsApp Business Solution Provider. Businesses use Samyoj to qualify leads, automate follow-ups, and sell across WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook Messenger — replacing slow manual follow-ups with automated, trackable sales journeys.

## What Samyoj Does

- **Unified omnichannel inbox**: WhatsApp, Instagram DMs and Facebook Messenger in one shared team inbox.
- **AI lead qualification**: AI agents respond and qualify leads 24/7, scoring and routing them in the CRM pipeline.
- **Automated follow-up sequences**: Timed, behavior-triggered follow-ups across channels.
- **Official WhatsApp Business API**: Verified business profile, green tick eligibility, broadcast messaging, catalogs, and Click-to-WhatsApp Ads integration.
- **CRM & pipeline**: Track every deal from first message to payment, with notes, reminders, and team assignment.

## Pricing (INR billing)

- **Launch (14-day free trial)**: ₹0 — 1 WhatsApp number, 1 team member, up to 100 contacts
- **Starter**: ₹999/month (₹800/mo billed annually) — 1 number, 3 members, 5,000 contacts
- **Growth**: ₹2,499/month (₹2,000/mo billed annually) — 2 numbers, 10 members, AI assistant included
- **Pro**: ₹4,999/month (₹4,000/mo billed annually) — 5 numbers, 25 members, advanced AI &amp; analytics
- **Enterprise**: custom — [talk to sales](https://samyoj.com/contact)
- Billing cycles: monthly, quarterly (5% off), annual (20% off)
- **Meta/WhatsApp usage charges**: billed at actuals with zero markup from Samyoj
- **AI/voice usage**: metered separately by consumption — not unlimited
- Details: [samyoj.com/pricing](https://samyoj.com/pricing)

## Key Facts

- Founded/work: AI-powered WhatsApp-first CRM built in India (Indore, Madhya Pradesh)
- Official Meta WhatsApp Business Solution Provider
- Setup: under 10 minutes to connect WhatsApp Business API
- Customer-reported results: 3× conversions (EdTechLab), 35%→90% engagement (Cosco), 150% higher response rates (HealthKart)
- Channels: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger
- Languages: English and Hindi support
